claims.proves: JSON-first status checking: pi.agent_status.v1 validated by pydantic against the triage-error catalog; ambiguous blocker labels rejected; no prose/regex classification. Proof[] paths are read back from disk before a done status can pass. Verified[] pairs are backed by proof text and known receipt schemas must pass.

capability_claims.description: status json required on mutating turn
not_done is only legal with state=continuing so unfinished work always queues a next command
status validity is controlled by final pi.agent_status.v1 pydantic validation, not regex or agent-authored prose
pydantic-valid done status cannot cite fake proof paths; proof[] entries must exist on disk
done.verified[] command/result pairs must appear in local proof text when local proof is supplied
known JSON proof receipt schemas are validated before done can pass
valid pi.agent_status.v1 data remains authoritative when prose appears after the JSON; renderer ignores trailing prose
